backtest_corpus.method: games credited in the live standings = sum(GP)/2; Week 10 games already credited = games final or in progress at read time; games through Week 9 = the difference
backtest_corpus.reviewer_claim: the brief asks for 'the 136-game log' to become the pre-registered corpus; no file at the base commit publishes 136 and the official arithmetic above gives a different number - see flag RF-01, which states both figures instead of quietly adopting either

report_record_vs_live_standings.reading: the bracketed record on the injury-report page equals the LIVE standings record for 28 of 28 clubs at read time - including the four clubs whose Week 10 games were still in progress and the clubs playing the 8:20 PM and Monday games that had not kicked off. So the record field is a live join, not a pre-game attribute of the report; a snapshot must store the record it saw with the clock time, and the model must never read it off the report table.
report_record_vs_live_standings.report_format_note: the report prints W-L and appends -T only when T>0 (NYG 5-3-1, WAS 3-5-1); the standings always print three numbers. Comparison is on the parsed triple.
